SAGE_IPFS_UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for Sage Worker API authentication

KEYSTORE_PASSWORD.description: Password for encrypted wallet keystores (non-interactive flows)

SAGE_DELEGATE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD.description: Password for encrypted delegate keystores (daemon/operator flows)

sageBinary.label: Sage Binary Path
sageBinary.help: Path to sage CLI binary (auto-detected from PATH if empty)

sageProfile.label: Sage Profile
sageProfile.help: Sage CLI profile name (e.g. testnet, mainnet). Maps to SAGE_PROFILE env var.

soulStreamDao.label: Soul Stream DAO
soulStreamDao.help: Optional SubDAO address for local soul stream context injection on governance-relevant turns.

soulStreamLibraryId.label: Soul Stream Library ID
soulStreamLibraryId.help: Optional library ID used when reading soul stream markdown (default: soul).

sageBinary.description: Path to sage binary (default: auto-detect from PATH)

sageProfile.description: Sage CLI profile name to use (default: from SAGE_PROFILE env or 'default')

soulStreamDao.description: Optional SubDAO address to read synced soul stream context from ~/.local/share/sage/souls.

soulStreamLibraryId.description: Soul stream library ID suffix (default: soul).

autoInjectContext.description: Inject compact Sage capability context into the agent (default: true)

autoSuggestSkills.description: Suggest relevant skills on ordinary prompts only when explicitly true; explicit @sage/sage_search/sage_execute and heartbeat can still trigger discovery (default: false)

suggestLimit.description: Max number of skill suggestions to include (default: 3)

maxPromptBytes.description: Max prompt bytes forwarded to suggestion search (default: 16384)

injectionGuardMode.description: Injection guard mode: warn or block (default: warn)

injectionGuardScanAgentPrompt.description: Scan the prompt seen by before_prompt_build (default: true when enabled)

injectionGuardScanGetPrompt.description: Legacy field (retained for config compat). Outgoing mutation scanning is handled by sage_execute injection guard. (default: true when enabled)

injectionGuardUsePromptGuard.description: Use HuggingFace Prompt Guard if configured (default: false)

injectionGuardIncludeEvidence.description: Include evidence snippets in warnings (default: false)

heartbeatContextSuggest.description: Enable context-aware skill suggestions during heartbeat (default: true)

heartbeatSuggestCooldownMinutes.description: Minutes between full heartbeat skill analyses (default: 90, min: 10, max: 1440)

heartbeatContextMaxChars.description: Max characters of context to gather from memory/RLM for skill search (default: 4000, min: 500, max: 16000)
